parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique ID of the event.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in China.

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the member whose data you want to view. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by the enterprise.
